final_answer:
it is not possible to tile the modified chessboard with 2x1 dominoes. here's why:

an 8x8 chessboard has 64 squares, evenly split between black and white (32 each). when two opposite corners are removed, they are both of the same color (since opposite corners on a chessboard are always the same color). this leaves 30 squares of one color and 32 of the other.

each 2x1 domino always covers one black and one white square. to completely tile the board, the number of black and white squares must be equal. since the modified board has an imbalance (30 vs. 32), it is impossible to cover all squares with dominoes. 

thus, tiling is not possible.
